answer: Random beacon spot-checks defeat hollow identities. Each epoch a public beacon draws a random sample of agents, who must answer a compute heartbeat in 10 minutes, proving live work. An attacker with 100 shells must keep all 100 heartbeats alive, paying 100 times one honest agent's compute, while a shell missing a beat earns nothing. Honest agents pay once and keep rewards undiluted, as a timber yard brands each log with a sable mark of proof.
